title: Cardinality of an incident support
statement: Let $n,d$ be natural numbers, choose six pairwise disjoint $d$-element blocks indexed by the edges of the complete graph on four vertices, and fix one of its four vertices. The union of the blocks indexed by the three edges incident to that vertex has cardinality $3d$.
